item.title: ICPC takes El-Rufai into custody after release by EFCC
item.description: Former Kaduna State governor, Nasir El-Rufai, has been taken into custody by the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC). El-Rufai was moved to the ICPC headquarter in Abuja after spending 48 hours at the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC), where he had earlier been granted bail. item.title: Police decorate 456 promoted officers in Benue, task them on professionalism
item.description: No fewer than 456 police officers in Benue State have been formally decorated following their recent promotion in a ceremony held at the command headquarters in Makurdi. The colourful event attracted top-ranking officers, family members and well-wishers who turned out to celebrate what many described as a defining moment in the careers of the beneficiaries. item.title: Nigerian govt orders closure of Plateau mining site after death of 37 miners
item.description: The Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dr Dele Alake, has ordered the immediate sealing of a mining site in Zuraq, Wase Local Government Area of Plateau State, following the death of 37 miners.
